intro: Camping 101: Alchemy is an introductory quest that bridges basic potion-making with wilderness survival. Alchemists are directed to Cyndra Kindwhisper in Dolanaar to learn how to construct a refreshing Mana Well for their campsites, providing vital magical replenishment to traveling casters and healers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.
I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
